description: Release a shared resource you claimed with claim_resource, as soon as the work that needed it ends (including a helper's: release it when the helper hands back). Pass the same label you claimed it with. Another holder's resource is refused, unless force is given, which is only for when the Developer says the holder is gone.

force.description: Release it even though someone else holds it. Only when the Developer asks.

label.description: Who it is held for when that is not this Session itself, such as 'helper: media run'. Claim and release a helper's lock with the same label.

resource.description: The shared thing's name, such as 'dev-window' or 'plasmashell'. Case and spaces do not matter.

name: release_resource
title: Release resource
